text:
Refund and compensation not received. I am raising a complaint regarding a damaged product I received from Smytten.
I received the product in damaged condition, so I returned it and requested a replacement. After returning the product, I contacted Smytten's customer support to ask about my replacement. I was then informed that they would not provide a replacement and would instead issue a refund.
However, the refund amount they offered was lower than the actual amount I had paid for the product. I discussed the issue with their customer support team for approximately one and a half hours. After repeatedly explaining the problem, they finally offered me a refund along with a ₹50 coupon as compensation.
Although I initially refused this offer, the support team told me that the product was out of stock and that they could not provide any other resolution. Therefore, I eventually agreed to receive the refund and the ₹50 coupon.
I was told that I would receive them within 1–2 days. However, it has now been around 4 days, and I have received neither the refund nor the ₹50 coupon.
I contacted Smytten again, and their team confirmed that they have already received my returned product at their warehouse. Despite this, I still have not received the promised refund or coupon.
I request Smytten to:
Process my pending refund immediately and ensure that the correct refund amount is credited.
Provide the ₹50 coupon that was promised to me by their customer support team.
Explain why the refund has been delayed even after the returned product was received at their warehouse.
I have already spent significant time contacting customer support and trying to resolve this issue. I expect Smytten to resolve the matter promptly rather than making me repeatedly contact customer support for the same issue.
Order ID: [5292203]
Product: [swiss beauty awaken eyeshadow palette]
Amount Paid: ₹[250]
Date of Order: [2nd aug, 2026]
title: Refund and compensation not received

text:
Complaint Against Smytten Non-Delivery of Paid Product & Deficient Customer Service. I placed an order on the Smytten app for two lipsticks under Shop Order Number #4823582. However, upon delivery, only one lipstick was received, while the second lipstick was missing from the package.
Despite this, the Smytten app shows both products as “delivered.” The delivery box and billing label clearly mention only one lipstick, which serves as proof that the second item was never shipped or delivered.
I immediately raised two support tickets regarding the missing product. Unfortunately, both tickets were closed without any investigation or resolution, even though the issue was not resolved.
After multiple attempts, I was able to connect with a Smytten customer support agent. I clearly explained several times that:
I did not receive one of the lipsticks
The app status incorrectly shows the product as delivered
I have proof in the form of the billing label and delivery package details
Despite providing this information, the support agent repeatedly stated that the order was delivered, refused to review the proof, and closed the conversation without clarification or assistance.
Additionally, I sent multiple emails to Smytten’s official support email ID regarding this issue and followed up several times. No response has been received to date.
This behavior reflects deficiency in service, misrepresentation of delivery status, and unfair trade practice.
I request the concerned authority to:
1. Direct Smytten to refund the amount for the undelivered lipstick OR deliver the missing product immediately
2. Take appropriate action against Smytten for closing complaints without investigation and providing misleading delivery information
I am willing to provide order details, ticket numbers, billing label photos, and screenshots as evidence if required.
title: Complaint Against Smytten Non-Delivery of Paid Product & Deficient Customer Service
